newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE white sugar edges higher after strong NY Oct.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE white sugar edges higher after strong NY Oct.

text.p: London's nearby white sugar futures perked up slightly on Wednesday afternoon after New York's spot raws contract saw renewed strength before its expiry next week, traders said.
But volume still remained extremely low after earlier trade buying kept values mostly above their opening levels.

"We were surprised to see the market steady now, especially in such low volume...everybody expected the market to go down," said one trader. At 1530 GMT December was up $1.40 at $329.00 and March up $1.30 at $328.50. Volume amounted to just 443 lots.
Technical analysts were bearish of the market and said it looked weak after the sharp falls at the start of last week.
Volume was heavier in Paris where 979 lots were traded. Both the December and March contracts were unchanged at $328.50.
